page_title: CAG 1-1 COM | Cagliari v Como 26/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' NO PENALTY after a VAR review! The Cagliari players are visibly unhappy with the call.
90+7' There's a break in play and referee Marco Di Bello must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Cagliari using VAR. This could be interesting!
90+7' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Cagliari for a penalty. Play continues.
90+7' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
90+6' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle. Alberto Cerri (Como) commits a foul after dangerous play.
90+5' The foul by Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) was seen by Marco Di Bello who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
90+4' Alberto Cerri (Como) receives the ball in space inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends his first-time shot well wide of the right post.
90+2' Alberto Cerri (Como) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it high over the bar.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Alberto Cerri (Como) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alberto Dossena trots off the pitch and is replaced by Edoardo Goldaniga (Como).
88' The linesman signals that Patrick Cutrone (Como) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
86' Razvan Marin (Cagliari) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Pepe Reina was alert and made a comfortable save.

83' Cagliari are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
81' Davide Nicola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) replacing Roberto Piccoli.
81' Tommaso Augello goes off the pitch and Adam Obert (Cagliari) comes on.
79' A quickly taken corner by Como.

79' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy. Como will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
75' The game gets underway again after that interruption.
74' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
71' A dangerous looking corner kick from Gabriel Strefezza (Como) is cleared to safety by the defence.

71' It's unbelievable, Nico Paz (Como) blows a huge opportunity! He is totally unmarked and fires a first-time shot towards the roof of the net, but Simone Scuffet reacts superbly to keep the ball out. The referee signals a corner kick to Como.
71' Como have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
70' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Patrick Cutrone (Como) inside the box. The ball goes out of play. Como are awarded a corner kick.
69' Cesc Fabregas decides to make a substitution. Luca Mazzitelli will be replaced by Sergi Roberto (Como).
67' Here is a change. Zito Luvumbo is going off and Davide Nicola gives the last tactical orders to Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari).
67' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cagliari.
67' We are about to witness a substitution. Jose Luis Palomino (Cagliari) is replacing Yerry Mina.

66' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Cagliari will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
65' Patrick Cutrone (Como) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
63' Marco Di Bello shows a yellow card to Razvan Marin (Cagliari) for his blatant foul.
62' Marco Di Bello interrupts the game. One of the players from Cagliari won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
62' Handball! A player from Cagliari handled the ball.
60' Substitution. Matteo Prati makes his way off the pitch and Michel Adopo (Cagliari) comes on as his replacement.
58' Cesc Fabregas has decided to make a change. Alberto Cerri (Como) replaces Andrea Belotti.
58' A substitution has been made. Lucas Da Cunha is replaced by Nico Paz (Como).
53' 1 - 1 Goal! The resulting corner is whipped into the box and Patrick Cutrone (Como) buries the ball into the back of the net from a Alberto Dossena knock down. 1:1.
53' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Como.
53' Patrick Cutrone (Como) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way. Como force their opponents to concede a corner.
51' Patrick Cutrone (Como) plays a through ball but overhits it.
50' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
49' Patrick Cutrone (Como) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Como have been awarded a corner kick.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Cesc Fabregas gives a chance to Maximo Perrone (Como) and Matthias Braunoder is off.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' 1 - 0 Goal! Sebastiano Luperto finds Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) with a headed pass and the latter glances a header past the goalkeeper to make it 1:0.
43' The free kick from long range, taken by Cagliari, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
41' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alberto Moreno (Como) was quite harsh and Marco Di Bello didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
40' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
38' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
36' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
35' Cagliari concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
34' Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the left post.
29' Razvan Marin (Cagliari) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
29' The match can continue after the interruption.
27' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
25' The Cagliari players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
23' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
21' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
17' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Di Bello had an easy-decision to make.
16' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
15' Razvan Marin (Cagliari) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

14' Razvan Marin (Cagliari) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari have been awarded a corner kick.

14' A wonderful opportunity! Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) strikes from close range and hits the ball nicely towards the bottom right corner. However, Pepe Reina makes a great save as he anticipates the shot and manages to parry it onto the post. The referee blows his whistle, Cagliari are awarded a corner kick.
12' Matthias Braunoder (Como) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
9' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Marco Di Bello saw the whole situation.
9' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
8' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Como is cautioned for aggressive play.
7' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
7' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
5' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
4' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
3' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Andrea Belotti (Como) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
2' A player from Como commits a rough challenge. Marco Di Bello blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Cagliari will have the kick-off.
Marco Di Bello will officiate today.
